verdict.rationale: Namecheap clearly exposes a programmatic XML API, plus a Go SDK and a Terraform provider. However, nothing in the pack shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec. The XML endpoint error responses, RDAP JSON output and SDK method tables are API surfaces or building blocks, not a published spec, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
